priorRuns: Earlier experiments are excluded; these are fresh measurements.

suites.method: Fresh process per variant per round. Rotate and reverse order so each variant occupies each position twice. Each process contributes one median per case.
suites.noiseRule: Independent 4-million-iteration CPU probes before/after each timed crawl; 5 warm-ups and 9 calibrations fix a 1.5x median threshold before launching any children. Exclude the entire three-variant round if any measured probe exceeds it. Require 4 accepted rounds; no filtering by candidate outcome.
